Type: nailhead upholstered accent armchair
Use: lounging, reading; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: traditional, contemporary, classic
Materials: woven upholstery fabric, antique brass nailhead trim, dark stained wood base and legs
Colors: warm greige, dark brown wood, bronze
Shape: track arms with nailhead outline, loose back and seat cushions, plinth-style wood base on tapered square legs, boxy, medium visual weight
Feel: tailored, refined, cozy
Goes with: dark wood, leather, cream walls, brass accents; classic or transitional living rooms

product.name: Stone & Beam Westport Modern Nailhead Upholstered Accent Arm Chair, 36"W, Stone Brown
product.description: Elevate your style with this head-turning modern chair. The deep seat is combined with a down-blend back cushion that is reversible. Nailhead trim on the arms and across the sides, along with the exposed wood base, adds extra sophistication. 36"W x 37.75''D x  33''H Durable polyester fabric; metal nailhead trim; wood legs. Removable, reversible back cushion enhances durability. No assembly required. Vacuum or wipe with soft dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
